description: Validates IaC stack definitions for platform and cloud validity, typed inputs, output coverage, no unresolved module refs, secret hygiene, approved providers, and environment completeness

rules.description: iac-spec.json must exist, be valid JSON, and declare platform, cloud, a non-empty environments array, and stateBackend. Both platform and cloud must be from the supported enum

For Terraform: every input declared in spec.inputs must have a matching variable block with a type annotation in the .tf files. For Pulumi/CDK: inputs must declare a type in the spec. Untyped inputs cause plan failures at the worst moment
rules.note: Skipped when spec.inputs is empty or absent
rules.terraformConstraint: Each input must have a corresponding variable block with a type = annotation in .tf files

rules.description: For Terraform: every output declared in spec.outputs must have a corresponding output block in the .tf files. Missing outputs break downstream modules and deployment scripts that reference them
rules.note: Skipped when spec.outputs is empty or absent; skipped for non-Terraform platforms

rules.description: For Terraform: every module block in .tf files must declare a source attribute. A module block without a source is a syntax error that terraform init rejects before plan or apply can run
rules.note: Skipped for non-Terraform platforms and when no .tf files are present

rules.description: All IaC files (.tf, .yaml, .ts, .py) must not contain hardcoded credentials. Detected patterns include access_key, secret_key, api_key, password, token assignments with long literal values, and AWS Access Key ID patterns (AKIA*). Use variable references or secret managers instead
rules.note: Skipped when no IaC files are found

rules.description: For Terraform: all providers declared in required_providers blocks must be on the approved list for the target cloud. Unapproved providers introduce unreviewed integrations that bypass cost controls, security policies, and compliance boundaries
rules.note: Skipped for non-Terraform platforms and when no .tf files are present

rules.description: iac-spec.json must not contain TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, or PLACEHOLDER markers

stateBackend must be a non-empty string (remote state required for team environments). environments must include both a production env (production/prod) AND a non-production env (staging/stage/dev/test). All object-typed inputs must have a description

constraints.stateBackend: Must be non-empty — remote state is required for multi-person teams
constraints.non-prod-env: environments must include a staging/stage/dev/test environment
constraints.inputs-description: All object-typed inputs must declare a non-empty description
